en: A vintage black-and-white postcard shows a panoramic view of a town surrounded by fields and hills. Prominently visible are clusters of old buildings and a notable church structure. The top of the postcard contains printed French text describing the view and location. The title 'YSSINGEAUX' is bolded, and the postcard is marked as part of a series called 'Le Velay Illustré.'
